title: Why Equil pump ver 5.2 not supported ?
symptom: The user asks if there are any problems adapting the Equil pump version 5.2 for AAPS, implying it is not supported.
cause: The pump does not support BT connectivity as needed by AAPS; specifically, AAPS driver only understands BLE 5.3, while the pump uses BLE 5.2.
evidence_quote: yes, it's BLE but AAPS driver "understands" only 5.3
